fact: Car 22 allegedly forcing Car 18 off track in Turn 3.
offence: Alleged breach Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 b) of the FIA International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video evidence. Car 22 overtook Car 18 on the inside in Turn 3. Car 22 had its front axle ahead of the mirror of Car 18 prior to and at the apex, the driver was in full control of the car from entry to apex and completed the overtake on track using a reasonable racing line. The Steward determine that all applicable requirements of the Driving Standards Guidelines have been fulfilled and take no further action.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Decision Car 22 Alleged Forcing Car 18 Off Track
to: The Team Manager, Oracle Red Bull Racing
